body: Alex is an absolute delight and a consummate professional. A perfectionist at her craft.

Alex is worth every penny. She has genuinely given me back my health, and I can't thank her enough!
A wonderful salon in a perfect rural location, much nicer than having to battle the traffic getting in to town and having to pay for parking.
My daughter and I ❤️ Alex.  She is professional and always give 5 star treatments. Alex is the only Therapist who I would trust with my feet ☺️
AMAZING. I had a gel manicure and pedicure and it really is the best I've ever had. Alex is lovely and very professional and I would highly recommend.
